def min_hackerX_missiles(N, missiles):
    missiles.sort()
    hackerX_missiles = []
    
    for time, freq in missiles:
        if not hackerX_missiles or hackerX_missiles[-1][0] > time:
            hackerX_missiles.append((time + abs(freq - 1), 1))
        else:
            next_available_time, _ = hackerX_missiles.pop()
            hackerX_missiles.append((next_available_time + abs(freq - hackerX_missiles[-1][1]), hackerX_missiles[-1][1]))
            hackerX_missiles.append((time + abs(freq - hackerX_missiles[-1][1]), hackerX_missiles[-1][1]))
    
    return len(hackerX_missiles)

# Read input
N = int(input().strip())
missiles = [tuple(map(int, input().strip().split())) for _ in range(N)]

# Output the result
print(min_hackerX_missiles(N, missiles))
